notes.title: Update Available - Separation of server and beta versions
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012336/f760e7e81e7957985e3890c250fb822eed658ec5.png"]
Mise à jour disponible - Séparation des versions serveur et bêta
We are starting a new development phase with two distinct versions of the game, both available as separate Betas on Steam.
Our goal is to give players the freedom to choose between the traditional Animalia experience and the Crossplay version via Epic Online Services (EOS).


Beta Structure
We will now have two permanent Betas inside Steam:

Nenhum (Default): The traditional version, just like it has always been since the beginning of Animalia.

Crossplayer (EOS): The former Public Test, now renamed and focused exclusively on Crossplay with Android.
[hr][/hr]Nenhum (Default)
This will be the main and standard Steam version.

No EOS, no Crossplay, and no Epic login.

All Epic-related integrations have been fully removed due to conflicts and bugs with the Steam system.

This version includes all the new content: new meshes, new playable animals, and the GMC system.

This is the classic base version, as players have known since the start of Animalia.
[hr][/hr]Crossplayer (EOS)
This version will remain separate as a dedicated Beta.

We have fully restored all Epic Online Services (EOS) functionality and Epic login.

Active Crossplay, initially with direct integration with Android.

This version will not be merged with the default version (Nenhum/Default).

Players will be able to choose freely between the two versions from their Steam Library.
[hr][/hr]Updates
Both versions will receive the same content updates.

This means:

There will not be two separate games with different content.

Any update or adjustment made in one version will also be implemented in the other.

We will constantly monitor both projects to ensure that maps, characters, and content remain synchronized.
[hr][/hr]Official Servers
Nenhum (Default): 4 official servers (3 with 50 slots and 1 with 100 slots).

Crossplayer (EOS): 3 official servers (all with 50 slots).

All servers will temporarily run in Sandbox mode, allowing players access to all animal growth stages.
[hr][/hr]Next Update
We are finishing an important fix for the "Plain" map materials.
Some changes applied in the Default version were not yet included in the Crossplayer version, but they will be delivered by tomorrow afternoon at the latest.

We will also implement the following fixes:
Lion:
Fixing the issue where the Baby Male Lion became transparent after birth.

Adjusting the Lioness model stretching issue when using the buffalo animation.
Leopard:
Reviewing tree climbing points to improve climbing mechanics.

Additional adjustments currently under testing.
New Map:
We will soon announce a new map inspired by the old "AfricanMap", but with a new name, a completely renewed look, and a much larger area.
The release will happen gradually, area by area.

Patch 132.0 Changelog:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012336/6019dce6a30d8f686e45bedf464efe8725bc83de.png

Hello everyone!

We know that many of you have been looking forward to the return of the Animalia update, and we want to start by thanking you immensely for your patience.

But now, with some tweaking and testing, we're happy to announce:

The update is back, and better!
- Critical bug fixes that affected gameplay and performance.
- Improvements to Animal systems such as balancing.
  (we're making adjustments to the hunger and thirst balancing)
- Graphical and performance optimizations

This is just the beginning - new updates are on the way with even more content and fixes!

IMPORTANT NOTICE – NEW STATUS AVAILABLE!

All animals now feature complete and detailed stats for each growth stage: Baby, Juvie, Sub Adult, and Adult.

From now on, each species has its own unique attributes such as:

Health
Stamina
Oxygen
Food
Water
Attack
Armor
Fortitude
Weight

This update allows for balanced combat analysis and better tracking of each animal's evolution!
Note that the stats may be adjusted at any time if any imbalance is found.

IMPORTANT - CONNECTING WITH EPIC GAMES ACCOUNT ON ANIMALIA

We're working to improve Animalia's cross-player integration, and we want to alert all players to an important point:

The game may ask you to connect to your Epic account via the NAVIGATOR. Be aware:

When prompted, the game will open an external browser window for you to log in with your Epic account.

Once logged in, you can press Alt+Tab and return to the game.

This process is safe and necessary to link your account correctly.

If the window doesn't open or crashes, we recommend:

Close and restart the game.

This step is essential to guarantee access to online features.

EASY ANTI-CHEAT (EAC)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012336/0654ce2284711fd55f47cd400857a26f52339b94.png

Animalia uses the Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) system to maintain the integrity and security of the game environment.

If you are experiencing errors when starting the game related to the EAC, follow the steps below to reinstall the service correctly.

HOW TO REINSTALL EASY ANTI-CHEAT - STEP BY STEP (STEAM VERSION):

1-Access the Animalia installation folder:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Animalia

2-Inside this folder, double-click on InstallAntiCheat or go to:
EasyAntiCheat Double-click on the file: EasyAntiCheat_Setup.exe

After that, try to open the game normally.

Important:

Make sure your antivirus or firewall isn't blocking the EAC.

Add the game and EAC to the exception list if necessary.

ANIMALIA NEWS - TWO NEW MAPS AVAILABLE!

ZSavannah - A wild and vibrant savannah, with dense vegetation and several biomes

⚠️ TECHNICAL NOTICE - DARK SHADOW ON ZSAVANNAH MAP
We have identified that some players may notice excessive dark shadows in certain areas of this map in particular. This is caused by a small graphical conflict with Unreal Engine 5's Lumen lighting system.

To reduce or eliminate this visual defect:

African Python - Now available as a playable species!

ANIMALIA MOBILE IN THE PLAY STORE! IN TEST!!!

Explore wildlife directly from your cell phone!
Animalia Survival coming to Android!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HBS.AnimaliaSurvival

NEW SERVER ORGANIZATION

As of the new update, we're implementing a server filter to improve your multiplayer experience!

SERVERS ARE NOW DIVIDED INTO TWO CATEGORIES:

✅ Official Servers

Managed by the Animalia team

With standardized rules and realism, stability and active support

Ideal for those looking for a more balanced and monitored experience

We will soon be officially announcing the rules for our servers, which will be divided into two types with the following modes:

✅ Realism
✅ Standardized rules

✅Unofficial servers

Created by the community
May contain modifications, customized rules and varied game styles.

IMPORTANT NOTICE - USE OF THE “OFFICIAL” TAG ON SERVERS

To ensure clarity, transparency and confidence in the Animalia multiplayer experience, we would like to inform you:

Unofficial servers may NOT use the “Official” tag in their names, descriptions or titles.

The “Official” tag is exclusive to servers managed directly by the Animalia team, who will have some of the DEVs overseeing them.

Only servers authenticated and maintained by the development team will have the [OFFICIAL] tag that will appear in the game filter.

ADMIN PANEL UPDATE

Attention, server administrators!

With the new update, we've made an important change to the Admin panel related to adding characters to the game:

🔄 Now, when adding an animal via the Admin panel, it will only have the Juvenile (Juv) stage.

❌ It will no longer be possible to directly select the Baby, SubAdult or Adult stages when adding the character.

Why this change?

To maintain more balance and natural progression in gameplay

To avoid abuse and unbalance in PvE/PvP servers and Realism

To encourage the gradual evolution of animals in the game environment

Growth continues to be possible normally from the baby stage during gameplay, according to the time and actions taken by the player.

IMPORTANT NOTICE - DISCONTINUATION OF THE OLD VERSION OF ANIMALIA
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40012336/1d1748368c6052aeca048090c74a22a415132635.jpg

Please note that the old version of Animalia will only be maintained until August 2025.

As of August, this version will be officially discontinued and will no longer receive updates, corrections or support.

Why this change?

Our focus is on the new version, which brings graphical improvements, a refined progression system, new maps, animals, bug fixes and greater stability.

Maintaining two versions limits our development and causes division in the community.

What you need to know:
~
The old version will continue to work until the beginning of August, but with limited resources and no new fixes.

We recommend that everyone migrates to the new version of Animalia, which is already available with several improvements.

Data from the old version will not be transferred and the saves have been changed, so if there is an animal saved in the slot, it will lose its progression.

This version is in the current steam version of the game. It will soon be moved to the “oldversion” tab in the Steam Beta branch. We recommend updating to the new version to continue receiving support and updates.

-Temporal Super Resolution (TSR) is a platform-independent Temporal Upscaler that allows the Unreal Engine to render beautiful 4K images. The images have a fraction of the cost by amortizing some of the expensive rendering calculations over many frames. It does this by rendering a lower internal resolution than the Temporal Anti-Aliasing Upsampling (TAAU) in Unreal Engine 4 could do.

TSR provides a native high-quality upsampling technique to meet the demands of next-generation games. It realizes the possibilities needed with the fidelity and detail required by Nanite geometry, allowing render frames at much lower resolution to accommodate sufficient performance for Lumen.

The comparison below demonstrates the difference in quality and performance between frames rendered in native 4K and those rendered in 1080p upscaled to 4K. With TSR, it is possible to achieve image quality close to 4K resolution while halving the GPU frame time.

Sorry for the delay in the update, but we wanted to fix common bugs first, so we made some big tweaks to the new engine, and as a result, we started a massive survey of patches and tweaks to both the game and our team, and in this update, we've added a lot of new features. We hired a new designer and animator to work on this project together, along with changing the engine to Unreal Engine 5, allowing us to incorporate new workings and mechanics into the game. We will be testing new features, as well as continuing to improve existing ones. We will be sharing more news with you all in the near future, and we'll work together to make sure it's as exciting as possible.

Gameplay

First off, we wanted to address gameplay. After receiving significant community feedback concerning Animalia, we are only able to make targeted fixes to keep the overall balance and feel of the game consistent while we continue to gather in-depth feedback from our passionate players. In short, we want players to develop an understanding of the system.
We value feedback from our players, and we are constantly working to address concerns raised by them. We hope that you continue to provide us with your thoughts and feedback. We're working on new features for the game, and we're excited to share them with the community.

In addition to making a general game change for the maps and fixing some common bugs with the skins and mechanics, the stats of all animals have been updated and revised, making them more balanced and fair. Additionally, the stats of all animals have been changed to better reflect their real-world counterparts. There are several animations that will be implemented in each animal, such as grabbing prey and climbing (which we have already tested with the Leopard). Also, we will integrate other animations into all animals.


In preparation for using Nanite, we have started tweaking the shaders for the foliage and rocks of both maps as well as the collisions of all the objects hidden inside them.

Due to the new account linking method, Animalia Staff should be informed if a login crash occurs, as those who were using the old method before the official update (public testing) might experience a crash when a friend is in the same session with them.

New game mode: Deathmatch

We are thrilled to introduce a new game mode to our community as well as a brand-new map, adding a new game mode to our multiplayer list. This mode offers a unique experience for players, and we hope others enjoy playing it as much as we do. A deathmatch is a game mode where players fight each other until all the players are eliminated. The objective is to kill as many players as possible while avoiding being killed yourself. When the game ends, the player with the most "Deathmatch" (DM) points will be the winner. We hope to see you on the field, doing your best to contribute your success. Be prepared for anything, and don't be afraid to get involved in the action.

Servers

We have been asked where the official servers are and why they are not populated. Our team is currently working on a solution to this issue. We apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused. We understand that we have been falling short in this area, and we are committed to making improvements. We are working on the official Animalia servers with an enhanced admin panel and new features, adding various regions to minimise the lag. Animalia's staff team will now be active on the official servers and we look forward to having the players in-game with us. We are planning to host events on the official servers, we will tell you guys more about that soon. We can't wait to see you there!

Since we are adding the official servers to the multiplayer list, we are looking to add a ticket system so that players can report and appeal bans. If you would like to see this feature added into our official discord, we would love to hear your thoughts.

Unreal Engine 5 & linking your account with Epic games

We are grateful for Unreal Engine 4, but we recognise that it is important for us to keep up with the latest technology so that our game can be even better. Unreal Engine 5 gives us more creative freedom by introducing new tools that have never been available before. We're excited to announce that we're working on something great and can't wait to tell you all about it!

Unreal Engine 5 (known as UE5) is the world's most powerful and integrated engine, bringing together high-quality graphics and visual design along with sound, lighting, animation and other capabilities.
In particular, UE5 allows for improved graphical resolution by removing the need for developers to separately specify how an object is illuminated, by replacing a global lighting engine, and the level of visual detail, by dynamically shrinking the higher resolution model. These alone make up a great deal of work on making the game look good; Dynamic lighting requires a lot of work, and designers often have to make multiple copies of each object and character with different levels of detail.

Nanite

Unreal Engine 5 goes granular. Nanite is a virtual geometry system that can help speed up the design process when working on large projects. It saves time by allowing designers to work with a reduced amount of detail. The software helps to reduce the level of detail required for importing objects, making it easier to use high-quality art. Nanite's data format is optimized for detecting and processing small details, and it can stream high-quality data with automatic level of detail.

Lumen

To create a realistic scene, the lighting must be accurate. Lumen is a tool that enables us to make quick changes to the lighting in their shots by adjusting it to match the time of day, the new light source (like a flashlight), or a sudden beam of light entering the scene. Adjusting lighting from open and dynamic scenes to every detail. Lumen uses infinite jumps and indirect specular reflection to diffuse mutual reflections in large, detailed environments on a scale from millimeters to kilometers.

Expansive Worlds

Unreal Engine 4 allowed us to create beautiful landscapes in Animalia, but Unreal Engine 5 takes it to a new level. With Unreal Engine 5 us developers can create even more intricate and realistic landscapes than ever before. Collaboration is made easier with the help of this software, it helps to speed up the process of creating something.

Animations

In order to be innovative, you need to keep evolving your ideas. Unreal Engine 5 offers powerful new animation tools, such as Control Ride. This tool allows us developers to control the movement of objects in 3D space, making it easier to create realistic animations. Now you can create rigs for multiple characters and share them with others. To create more natural movements, we can use Full-Body IK solver to save and apply poses. This can help us to move with more fluidity and ease, resulting in more efficient and effective workouts.

MetaSounds

Metasounds can help us to control audio in a variety of ways, as well as being more flexible than traditional audio methods. The software helps us to manage every aspect of a sound experience more effectively. This allows us to create more realistic audio effects and improve the overall quality of our audio products.

Other top additions and fixes

Animals

Changed all animal stats to a new version.
We changed the status of all animals for a better configuration, before they were all done on each animal and its individual stages. Now, we have a table that allows you to configure each status individually without having to go through each blueprint.

Added new event for critical damage (stun).
With critical damage, an animal can fall stunned in the middle of a battle if it suffers a very strong attack. This can happen even if the animal's health is already low, so it's important to take care when attacking.

Implementation of the day/night cycle in Animalia along with updated night vision. Keeping night-time frightening but also interesting and engaging to play through is key. We focused on making the environment feel oppressive and dark and create unique encounters that keep players on their toes.

Now with the introduction of Lumen and Nanite from Unreal Engine 5, DirectX has been permanently changed to DirectX12. This new version of DirectX is more efficient and allows for more realistic graphics and gameplay.

Nvidia cards

Since 2010, NVIDIA graphics cards have been compatible with DirectX 12.x. This means that many of the graphics cards currently available work with this new version of DirectX. Additionally, all laptop versions of these cards are already compatible.

notes.title: Leopard Update - Patch 0.3
notes.notes:
Hello Wild Friends! 

This is to inform you about the updates on Animalia Survival Alpha 2.0.

First thing, here it's a list of fixed and improved things in this update

 bug fixed ⫸ Lion drinking animation.
 bug fixed ⫸ Water box fixed.
 bug fixed ⫸ Elephant Attack box range.

 improvement ⫸ Collision between animals added
 improvement ⫸ Scent mechanic added.
  improvement ⫸ New tree added.
 improvement ⫸ Many minors bugs and boring things fixed :).

 removed ⫸ X button for speed increase removed

new playable animal ⫸ African Leopard

Collision System

So, this are the changes available so far, the collision system can change the gameplay for attack and defense, since animals can't go trough each other anymore, that is for create a more realistic gameplay in the future, especially with big groups where the animal cant share the exact same area with others, river crossing, defense of the nestlings, and so on. But this may cause some bugs with the terrain recognition, lets test it.

Scent Mechanic

Scent mechanic added, little rough but necessary. Now players can see eatable plants (glowing green), carcass and dead bodies (glowing red) by clicking on "Q".

Elephant big hit

Elephant attack box improved, so now it can hit anyone... Thomson's Gazelles be aware!

African Leopard and the future

New tree added for performance and optimization test (it has to do with leopard climbing and future updates)
And the highly anticipated African Leopard was added, male and female, with the basic moves, climbing is not a thing yet, im sorry...that needs vegetation changes to work appropriately so we cant end with a leopard bat in the trees, hanging upside down...we want it to work well and for you to be able to move around up there, jump to specific places, according to the player's will, carrying bodies to the heights and all of this special and good things.

I would like to say that we are taking your suggestions on board, many of them are already part of the plan, but it's nice to see that we are moving in the same direction that you want.
From this update on, we believe Animalia will go through major changes, for the better of course :)

Its a simple update, but each day that goes by, we are closer to get the game we all want. We are very happy with the support of each one of you and with what the future holds for Animalia Survival.

We are also working on the Animalia website, with a forum and members' area. 
And the configurations for the Dedicated Servers are almost ready, and we are working to make this happen as soon as possible.

We hope you stay well and continue with us to see what we have in store for you! We can only say Obrigado for now...
